title: Beaufort Castle and the ground around it
summary: Within 5.5 km of the castle, since 1 March 2026: 79 fires, 50 white phosphorus attacks and 17 displacement orders, and the damage the Village Studio mapped in Yohmor and Zawtar El Sharqiyeh.

steps.title: The castle above the Litani
text: Beaufort Castle, Qalaat al-Shqif, stands on a cliff above the gorge of the Litani River, between the towns of Arnoun and Yohmor in the district of Nabatieh. The Israeli army held it from 1982 to 2000.

This investigation reads the ground within 5.5 km of the castle: the 13 places of the gazetteer whose points fall inside that circle, among them Arnoun, Yohmor, Deir Mimas, Burj al-Mulouk, Al-Qlaiaah and Kfar Tebnit.

steps.title: What the corpus holds around it
text: Within the circle the corpus holds 79 fires, 50 white phosphorus attacks and 17 displacement orders. Each kind was collected and is counted apart, so the counts are not added together.
Displacement orders name a town, so they shade the whole municipality; fires and white phosphorus are counted by town, each mark growing with the records there.

steps.title: Fire on the slopes
text: 79 fires linked to an Israeli attack burned at these places between 10 March 2026 and 4 October 2026, the most in July 2026 (22).

By what lit them: 54 by an explosion, 16 with no attack linked to them, 6 by white phosphorus, 2 by an incendiary munition and 1 by illumination flares. Where a burn scar was measured on Sentinel-2, 50 of them cover 1,081.0 ha between them.
steps.note: A burn scar says ground burned, and the record says what is documented about the attack. Hectares exist only where a scar was measured.

steps.title: White phosphorus over the valley
text: 50 white phosphorus attacks are recorded at these places, from 3 March 2026 to 8 October 2026.
16 were geolocated, placed on the ground from footage, a satellite detection or a burn scar, and 34 are known by their village. On the map each town's diamond grows with the attacks recorded there.

steps.title: Yohmor, read building by building
text: The village damage report read Yohmor, with the castle and the ground within 1.5 km of the town, on sharp satellite pictures.
It mapped 245 buildings destroyed and 30 damaged.
steps.note: Each change appears on the day it was first seen on a picture, which is when it entered the record, not necessarily when it happened.

steps.title: Zawtar El Sharqiyeh, on the river
text: Zawtar El Sharqiyeh lies on the Litani below the castle.
Its damage report saw 262 buildings change on Sentinel-2 and 1 damaged on sharp pictures.
steps.note: A 10 m Sentinel-2 pixel is about one house: it says the ground at a building changed, not which house.

steps.title: Read it yourself
text: Open the database on Beaufort to filter the figures by kind, date and column, read each town's counts and play the timeline from 1 March 2026. The records themselves are not published; to access them, contact Green Southerners.
